verdicts.reason: A and B are nearly pixel-identical. Both keep the purple headline panel centred and readable. Both have the same flaws: a faint, lighter translucent band runs edge to edge behind the panel and looks like a leftover artifact, and the photo is crop-zoomed and visibly soft. The panel also crowds the left edge more than the right. A's headline is a hair larger with slightly tighter leading, and B's has marginally more padding. That difference isn't enough to separate them.
